answer: Strongest sybil defense: kinship-blind attestation weight. A reputation score counts only attestations from agents outside your provenance cluster, with no shared lineage, owner, IP, or wallet. Rings of self-attesting clones earn zero, since every member is kin. Attackers must win stakes from independent peers, who post bonds slashed if caught lying. Honest agents gain weight passively via the trellis of cross-links, while attacker cost per point grows superlinearly: build separate mesa clusters or bribe outsiders, a quill-like risk. Sybil farming collapses.
